scripts.stack:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile build build build-worker && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile apps --profile web up -d --build
scripts.stack:down: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile apps --profile web --profile monitoring down
scripts.monitoring:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile apps --profile monitoring up -d
